card.name: Linking words after patients in risk statements
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "with", "in" or "at" that follow "patients" or a risk term in warnings. They come right before the patient group or condition, such as severe aortic stenosis or elderly patients.

modes.label: with after patients
modes.description: The word "with" right after "patients", before a named condition.
modes.example: Symptomatic hypotension is possible, particularly in patients<< with>> severe aortic stenosis.

modes.label: in or at before group or dose
modes.description: "in" or "at" in a risk statement, before a patient group or dosage.
modes.example: Respiratory depression occurs most frequently<< in>> elderly or debilitated patients, usually

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted or suppressed tokens, which are mixed and mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that introduces which patients or conditions a warning applies to.
